introHtml: Travel size medical healthcare items are designed for professionals and teams who need essential safety and wellness products that fit in a pocket, glove box, or carry-on. Whether you're equipping field crews with compact first aid kits or handing out branded hand sanitizers at a trade show, these smaller versions make it easy to keep health top of mind without taking up space. Options like mini pill boxes and travel-size sunscreen tubes can be imprinted with your logo for practical, visible branding.
